h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bilaspur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bilaspur

items.pText: Bilaspur is the second city of Chhattisgarh, home to the state's High Court and the headquarters of a railway zone, with coal mining and power plants in the surrounding district. Railway and public-sector colonies, schools, institutes and private townships make up most of the demand for play areas. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Bilaspur from our factory in Vasai, about 1,010 km away.

A colony park run by a railway or public-sector body is often maintained by a small civil team with many other duties. For these sites we suggest equipment that is simple to look after: solid swings, slides, see-saws and climbers, fixed by grouting, with few small parts. Chhattisgarh summers are hot and the monsoon is heavy, so a well-drained base with rubber flooring matters as much as the equipment.

items.q: Which playground equipment needs the least maintenance?
items.a: Pieces made mostly of galvanised pipe and roto-moulded plastic, such as slides, climbers and see-saws. Swings and merry-go-rounds have bearings and chains that need a monthly check.

items.q: Do you supply railway and public-sector colonies?
items.a: We supply any buyer who needs playground equipment, including colony parks. We can share the layout drawing, equipment list and warranty terms needed for your internal approval.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Bilaspur?
items.a: Yes. Equipment is made at our Vasai factory and sent to Bilaspur by road. Our team or a dealer in Chhattisgarh installs it.
